description: Gets a link a person can open to watch the remote browser your CDP connection is driving, and take control of it: the same tabs, cookies and page. Use it when a page needs a human: a login, a one-time code, a captcha. Send them `live_view_url`; they press "Take control", do the step, and give control back. While they have it, your connection's input and navigation commands fail with error -32001 (reading the page still works); poll spicrawl_browser_control (action `status`) until `controller` is `agent`, then carry on. The link works once and must be opened within 60 seconds; ask again for a new one. The session must still be connected. Watching costs nothing beyond the session itself.

session_id.description: The remote browser session, as `session_id` from spicrawl_browser_connect_url. It exists while that connection is open.

name: spicrawl_browser_live_view

expires_in.description: Seconds the link stays valid if not opened (60).

live_url.description: The bare live-view WebSocket, for building your own viewer.

live_view_url.description: A page a person opens in their browser to watch and take control. Single use, open within 60 s.

title: Live view link for a remote browser
